camel_example: aliyun gpdb DescribeNamespace --region cn-hangzhou --ManagerAccountPassword testpassword --ManagerAccount testaccount --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace mynamespace
description_en: Queries the information about a namespace
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-namespace --manager-account testaccount --manager-account-password testpassword --namespace mynamespace --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNamespace

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the manager account that has the rds_superuser permission.

You can create an account on the Account Management page of the AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361789.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
具有rds_superuser权限的管理账号名称。

您可以通过控制台->账号管理来创建账号，或者通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361789.html接口创建
parameters.name: manager_account

parameters.help_en: The password of the manager account
parameters.name: manager_account_password

parameters.help_en:
The name of the namespace. Default value: public.

命名空间，默认为public。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html接口查看列表
